# Enhanced Enums

enum Color {
  red(1),
  blue(2);
  final int value;
  const Color(this.value);
}

==>

Program(Declaration(EnumDeclaration("enum",Identifier,"{",EnumBody(EnumEntry(Identifier,ArgumentList("(",Argument(Literal(NumberLiteral)),")")),",",EnumEntry(Identifier,ArgumentList("(",Argument(Literal(NumberLiteral)),")")),";",MemberDeclaration(VariableDeclaration("final",Type(TypeNoQuestion(TypeIdentifier(Identifier))),Identifier,";")),MemberDeclaration(VariableDeclaration("const",Pattern(PrimaryPattern(ObjectPattern(TypeNoQuestion(TypeIdentifier(Identifier)),"(","⚠"("this"),"⚠"("."),PatternField(Pattern(PrimaryPattern(Identifier))),")"))),";"))),"}")))
